manifest_records.assigned_use: Seeds active course catalog with titles, URLs, subjects, levels, pricing, duration, and subscriber metrics.
manifest_records.deduplication_method: Exact deduplication on (url, course_id). 6 exact duplicate rows identified and linked.
manifest_records.quality_issues: Lacks explicit granular skill tags; requires candidate NLP skill extraction from title and subject.
manifest_records.restrictions: Extracted skill tags labeled as unverified suggestions. Free courses prioritized before paid courses.

manifest_records.assigned_use: Internal descriptive analysis of target leakage, class imbalance, and fairness safeguards. Zero predictive use.
manifest_records.deduplication_method: All 25,000 rows audited on student_id. No duplicates detected.
manifest_records.quality_issues: Extreme target leakage: 98.4% placed (24,596) vs 1.6% unplaced (404); post-outcome leakage variables (offer_count=0 strictly when not placed; salary_lpa=0 strictly when not placed; joining_delay_months).
manifest_records.restrictions: STRICT RESTRICTION: Quarantined from predictive modeling. NEVER used to train a placement predictor or recommend learners.

manifest_records.assigned_use: Primary scraped job opportunities directory; ingestion, URL validation, and normalization.
manifest_records.deduplication_method: Composite deduplication on Link and Position. 28,459 within-file exact duplicates; 540 distinct rows share identical URLs.
manifest_records.quality_issues: Massive 94.6% duplication rate; missing full job descriptions and explicit skill tags.
manifest_records.restrictions: Duplicates linked to canonical source records without double-counting; only distinct URL records promoted to active listings.

manifest_records.assigned_use: Internship ingestion directory. Unknown locations and opportunity types preserved as unknown without invention.
manifest_records.deduplication_method: Composite deduplication on (Position, Company, Link). 18,344 exact duplicates; 501 distinct rows share identical URLs.
manifest_records.quality_issues: 93.9% duplicate rate; 100% of locations missing/null in source; 73% missing opportunity type.
manifest_records.restrictions: Missing locations preserved as 'Unknown' (never fabricated). Only records with validated URLs promoted.

manifest_records.assigned_use: Hackathon ingestion, link verification, deadline validation, and event-status QA. Missing deadlines preserved as unknown.
manifest_records.deduplication_method: Composite deduplication on (Title, Organisations, Link). 3,360 exact duplicates; 499 distinct rows share identical URLs.
manifest_records.quality_issues: 75.6% duplicate rate; 948 of 1,085 unique rows lack explicit application deadlines in raw source.
manifest_records.restrictions: Missing deadlines remain unknown. Valid URLs verified before promotion.

manifest_records.assigned_use: Seeds active course catalog and candidate skill mappings via 'all_skill' field.
manifest_records.deduplication_method: Deduplicated on (Course URL, Course Name). 98 exact duplicates identified and linked.
manifest_records.quality_issues: Skill tags are noisy, space-delimited, and mix broad disciplines with specific tools; Latin-1 encoding.
manifest_records.restrictions: Tags reconciled against canonical platform taxonomy. Ambiguous mappings flagged for review.

manifest_records.assigned_use: Seeds verified demo opportunities feed across jobs, internships, and hackathons.
manifest_records.deduplication_method: Primary key ID deduplication on (id, sourceUrl). 200 distinct records.
manifest_records.quality_issues: 177 of 200 rows missing eligibility (displayed as 'Not provided'); 5 deadlines prior to current date (marked 'expired').
manifest_records.restrictions: Expired items quarantined or labeled 'expired'. Missing eligibility explicitly rendered as 'Not provided' rather than inferred.

manifest_records.assigned_use: NPTEL academic curriculum reference catalog. Course-level dates evaluated against current system date.
manifest_records.deduplication_method: Header offset parsing (skiprows=10). 1,054 unique Course ID noc26-* records.
manifest_records.quality_issues: Banner metadata in first 9 rows. Course instruction ended October 9, 2026; examination window ends late October 2026.
manifest_records.restrictions: All 1,054 records archived with state 'historical' since instruction and enrollment have passed. Shown only as reference curriculum.

manifest_records.assigned_use: Seeds academic course catalog with university listings, institutions, descriptions, and difficulty levels.

manifest_records.quality_issues: 561 courses missing syllabus; 40 courses missing descriptions.
manifest_records.restrictions: Missing syllabus and descriptions explicitly noted. Candidate skill tags mapped from title/summary.
